question: On 26 January 1950 India became:
solution:
The correct answer is__** a sovereign, democratic, republic state**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **26 January 1950**, India officially became a **sovereign, democratic, republic state**.
 
• This date marks the adoption of the **Constitution of India**, which laid down the legal framework for the country.
 
• The Constitution was adopted by the **Constituent Assembly** on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It established India as a republic, meaning that the head of state is elected, not a hereditary monarch.
 
• It also declared India as a sovereign state, indicating its independence from any external control.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written constitution** in the world and provides for a democratic system of government.
 
• It assures its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity among them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India also declares the nation to be **socialist and secular**, terms that were added by the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
 
• The Constitution outlines the fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and duties of citizens.
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists: the Union List, the State List, and the Concurrent List, delineating the subjects under which each level of government has legislative powers.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Constitution has been amended multiple times to address the evolving needs of the nation.
